name: Mishaguji
source: A dragon with the ability to shapeshift into a human to help protect the hot springs town. Originally he was the master of the swamp until most of his power was taken from him. He loves sex with beautiful girls and has the magical ability to restore a girl's virginity even after he has sex with her and can control whether or not his semen will make a girl pregnant or not. After being defeated by Ibuki and Nazuna he promises not to rape anymore in exchange for living in the hot springs town.
